## MKV Track Organizer 1.0.19

This release adds another safe automatic dependency install path.

### Added

- **Install/Update selected** support for Subtitle Edit in the Config tab Dependency Manager.
- Generic GitHub ZIP dependency installer shared by `seconv` and Subtitle Edit.
- Automatic architecture selection between `SubtitleEdit-Windows-x64.zip` and `SubtitleEdit-Windows-ARM64.zip`.

### Notes

- Supported automatic installs are still local to `_tools`; they do not run system installers or modify global Windows paths.
